author: Praxis I
title: BRBG-Dual-AdaptPC: Exact Balanced Quotas (k=45) with Adaptive Residualization
abstract: Imposes exact per-batch quotas so total degree equals k=45 (q=floor(k/B) per batch plus rotating r extras). Uses adaptive per-PC residualization (γ_j=min(0.74, 0.9·R²_j)) and ComBat-PCA64 embedding. Tests true k=45 vs prior ceil-based k≈48 behavior.
